# Zones and map

The map side of an Operation: LevelDesign items and tags, zones and their owners, the playable zone, the AI grid and the camera.

Topic `zones-and-map`, declared by ops. Back to [the map](../README.md).

## Mechanisms

### PLAYED

- [ai-grid-tiles-playable-zone](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/ai-grid-tiles-playable-zone.md): The AI strategic grid must tile the playable zone (ops, verified 201602)
- [count-race-forced-owner](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/count-race-forced-owner.md): Decide a zone by a timed unit count, then force its owner so the map shows it (ops, verified 201602)
- [deployment-phase-recipe](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/deployment-phase-recipe.md): A deployment phase needs six parts, and buying after the launch needs player arrival entries (ops, verified 201602)
- [detector-circles-only](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/detector-circles-only.md): DetectUnitDansDetecteur works only on circular zones (ops, verified 201602)
- [leveldesign-guid-binding](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/leveldesign-guid-binding.md): A script names a map item by the four words of the item's GUID in LevelDesign (ops, verified 201602)
- [zone-capture-command-units](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/zone-capture-command-units.md): Only command units capture a zone, and an enemy command unit inside makes it neutral at once (ops, verified 201602)
- [zone-lookup-by-point](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/zone-lookup-by-point.md): Zone conditions find their zone by a tag's point, and a point in no zone fails silently (ops, verified 201602)

### STOCK

- [arrival-end-in-zone](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/arrival-end-in-zone.md): Every player arrival entry must end inside a deployment zone of its side or a command zone (ops, verified 201602)
- [camera-shot-from-current-position](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/camera-shot-from-current-position.md): Mid-battle, a script flies the camera from wherever it is to a one-key path, in a cutscene that can hold the view (ops, verified 201602)
- [start-camera-before-loading-done](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/start-camera-before-loading-done.md): An Operation that opens in the deployment phase sets its opening camera after LoadingDone, a move then a snap to its last key (ops, verified 201602)

### FAILED

- [created-units-stand-in-zone](../../components/ops/knowledge/mechanisms/created-units-stand-in-zone.md): A script cannot hide a unit outside the playable zone; a unit created there stands on the zone's edge, where the player's units see and engage it (ops, verified 201602)

## Lessons

Taught by the trials of these mechanisms.

- [counting-parts-is-not-checking](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/counting-parts-is-not-checking.md) (ops): Counting the parts of a recipe is not checking them
- [crash-box-hides-the-error](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/crash-box-hides-the-error.md) (core): A crash box hides the real error; read the dump before guessing
- [debrief-by-what-the-map-shows](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/debrief-by-what-the-map-shows.md) (core): Design probe results to show on the map, and debrief with a few multiple-choice questions about what was seen
- [decide-zones-by-count](../../components/ops/knowledge/lessons/decide-zones-by-count.md) (ops): Decide zone rules by timed counts and force the owner; keep real captures for flavour
- [fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/fix-loop-after-a-failed-launch.md) (core): After a failed launch, find the root cause, gate it, fix, reinstall hash-checked, and update the play sheet
- [gates-model-the-game-lookup](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/gates-model-the-game-lookup.md) (core): A gate checks the data where the game reads it, not just that it exists somewhere
- [one-stall-hides-the-rest](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/one-stall-hides-the-rest.md) (core): Put each probe beat in its own parallel branch, so one stall cannot hide the rest
- [prove-each-gate-both-ways](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/prove-each-gate-both-ways.md) (core): A gate is proven when it fails the bad build with the game's own words and passes every stock file
- [recorded-recipe-becomes-a-gate](../../components/core/knowledge/lessons/recorded-recipe-becomes-a-gate.md) (core): A recipe recorded in research must become a gate, or the next generator drops part of it
